partners.mechanism_chain: POLR1C (HGNC:9069) —DISRUPTS→ RNA polymerase I transcription (GO:0006358); POLR1D (HGNC:9071) —DISRUPTS→ RNA polymerase I transcription (GO:0006358); RNA polymerase I transcription (GO:0006358) —LEADS_TO→ Mandibulofacial dysostosis (HP:0000343); RNA polymerase I transcription (GO:0006358) —LEADS_TO→ Conductive hearing impairment (HP:0000405); RNA polymerase I transcription (GO:0006358) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormalities of the ear (HP:0000388); RNA polymerase I transcription (GO:0006358) —LEADS_TO→ Craniofacial abnormalities (HP:0000272). Disruption of either POLR1C or POLR1D leads to impaired RNA polymerase I transcription, which is essential for ribosomal RNA synthesis.
